contracts: POST /api/studio/configuration/experiments/export: owner/CSRF protected, exact experiment/dataset revisions, reviewed reference files or diagnostics with no partial files.
POST /api/studio/configuration/experiments/handoff/convert: owner/CSRF protected, strict bounded versioned JSON and digest, existing conversion preflight, native draft only.

validation.example: Existing thin import consumer now verifies declaration/handoff round-trip without starting a run.
validation.execution: Reviewed handoff apply retains old suite and updates experiment; six target slots plus six judge calls pass through an injected synthetic provider, preserving variants, repeats, worker count and threshold.
validation.static: Affected Python lint, new/edited example formatting, JavaScript syntax, JSON checkpoint parsing and diff whitespace pass.
validation.browser: Visual browser acceptance pending; the prior localhost permission denial was not retried or bypassed.
validation.live_provider: No external provider invoked. Synthetic execution only.

guarantees: Export and handoff conversion create no saved state, plans or runs
Explicit current revision and effective-case matching; changed dependencies reject
Unsupported native settings produce path/code diagnostics and no partial files
Native thresholds, variants, copied evaluators, primary identity and all-evaluator policy survive native handoff reimport
Reimport uses separate conversion review, plan review and explicit save
No automatic download; each prepared file requires an explicit click
No artifact bytes, dataset contents, grader instructions, target definitions or credential values are embedded
Real input/reference artifact fixtures remain unopened during export
Strict duplicate-key, finite-number, version, field, size and digest checks
Descriptive source identity never fetches or authorizes another experiment
Target edits after export reject conversion before a new plan
Existing native JSON export remains available and unchanged
limits: Declaration YAML alone cannot preserve native execution semantics; the companion is required for native round-trip
Reference export requires dependencies already present at exact current revisions; it is not a self-contained resource/deployment package
Workflow targets, inline-only judges, custom nonportable IDs and changed evaluator copies use native configuration export instead
Original standalone suite judges are not exported; imported suite uses copied primary while named experiment uses all selected copies
Digest detects corruption, not authorship or authority
Visual browser, physical-device and live-provider acceptance remain pending
migration: No persisted-state migration; new handoff file format is independently versioned as nexus-studio-experiment-handoff/v1.
next: Reviewed dataset/evaluator declaration package export with strict representability diagnostics.
